entry.title: dotnet/sdk - Issues & Pull Requests - 2026-02-11
entry.content:
Issues

Created

  • Static Web Asset manifest is sometimes not produced by web project build #52994
  • Many Microsoft.CodeAnalysis.NetAnalyzers.UnitTests tests have duplicate test cases #52993
  • Need to rationalize MSBuildForwardingApp in AOT scenarios #52988
  • Need to address SDK folder location with AOT #52987
  • We need to document the ProjectCapability Items that the .NET SDK (and other SDKs in this repo) provide #52984
  • Collect telemetry data about how many evaluations various CLI activities cause #52983
  • .NET 11 Interactive Framework and Device Selection is nice, but remove any TFM where the OutputType isn't set to Exe. #52982
  • GitHub Actions: dotnet dev-certs https --trust failes since version 10.0.103 #52978
  • [dotnet-sdk-11.0.100-preview.2.26110.101] Execute commands "dotnet tool install -g XXX" or "dotnet tool install -global XXX" get error: Unhandled exception: Object reference not set to an instance of an object. #52976
  • dotnetup: Support Windows Terminal profile configuration #52964
  • `dotnet sdk check` command is not working in .NET 11 Preview 1 #52963

Closed

  • Reenable ApplyDeltaTests.AddSourceFile #52576
  • [MTP][dotnet test] Add test for a test app that starts a child process where the child process doesn't terminate #51507
  • dotnet watch run --no-hot-reload suppresses stdout output #51856
  • NU1701 Warning Not Suppressed by NoWarn="NU1701" on PackageReference (dotnet restore / build) #52977
  • [dnceng-bot] Branch `sdk/release/9.0.3xx` can't be merged to Azdo internal branch #52965
